Hotels.Name: Le Bristol Paris
Hotels.Description:
Since opening its doors in 1925, Le Bristol has become a treasured Parisian institution, offering guests a truly luxurious experience in one of the city’s most desirable spots. You’ll find it on Rue du Faubourg-Saint-Honoré, a street lined with upscale restaurants, designer boutiques and art galleries aplenty – a fitting setting for a hotel that oozes elegance and opulence throughout.

The iconic Avenue des Champs-Élysées is just around the corner from here, running nearly two kilometres from the Place de la Concorde to the Arc de Triomphe – so you could hardly pick a more convenient base for exploring Paris on foot. There’s also a metro station (Miromesnil) a couple of minutes away, from which you can get to the Eiffel Tower or the Louvre in around 10 minutes.

When you’re not out and about exploring, the hotel’s central garden is a beautifully serene place in which to relax over a coffee or a glass of wine – a fragrant, green oasis that feels a world away from the busy city streets. Be sure to also check out the heated swimming pool and sun deck on the sixth floor, or treat yourself to a blissfully soothing massage or skin treatment at the spa.

Dining here is no ordinary experience; the hotel boasts its very own Three Michelin Star restaurant (Epicure) as well as a One Michelin Star brasserie (114 Faubourg), both showcasing exquisite, modern French cuisine with innovative twists. You may also be tempted to stop by Cafe Antonia for a drink or a casual bite to eat, and the plush lounge bar for late night signature cocktails and DJ sets. 

Expect spacious rooms bathed in natural light, each uniquely decorated with original artwork and stylish furnishings that create a warm, cosy and quintessentially Parisian ambience.
